settings.text: Shipping, pickup, preorders, returns and payments. Can't find your answer? Contact Dean.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: $10 to Sydney Metro, Gosford and Wollongong. $15 to the rest of Australia. Free on orders over $300.

settings.question: When will I receive my order?
settings.answer: In-stock games are dispatched in 1-3 business days. Games we order in from our supplier ship in 2-7 business days. Delivery time after that depends on AusPost.

settings.question: Can I track my parcel?
settings.answer: Yes. Every order goes by Australia Post eParcel with tracking. You'll get the tracking link by email when it ships.

settings.question: Do you ship overseas?
settings.answer: We ship within Australia only. For overseas orders, email us for a quote.

settings.question: What if I'm not home?
settings.answer: AusPost will leave a card and hold the parcel at your local post office, or you can deliver to a Parcel Locker. Uncollected parcels returned to us incur a $13.43 return fee plus reshipping.

settings.question: Can I pick up my order?
settings.answer: Yes, free. Choose Local pickup at checkout and collect on Tuesday night at the Northside Gamers Group in Chatswood.

settings.question: When will my pickup be ready?
settings.answer: Orders placed on a Monday or Tuesday are ready the following Tuesday. We confirm by email.

settings.question: When is my preorder due?
settings.answer: Each preorder shows its expected month. Dates come from the publisher and can move; we update the product page if they do.

settings.question: When am I charged?
settings.answer: At purchase, usually at a discounted preorder price.

settings.question: Will my in-stock items wait for my preorder?
settings.answer: Yes. In-stock items in the same order are held and shipped together when the preorder arrives. If you'd like them sooner, place them as a separate order.

settings.question: Can I cancel a preorder?
settings.answer: Yes, any time until the stock ships from our supplier. Email us and we'll refund you.

settings.question: Can you order a game you don't stock?
settings.answer: Often, yes. We source games from around the world. Tell us what you're after.

settings.question: Do I need an account to buy?
settings.answer: No. You can check out as a guest. An account lets you see past orders and reorder quickly.

settings.question: How do I check my order status?
settings.answer: Use the link in your order confirmation email, or sign in to your account and open Orders.

settings.question: Can I add items to an order that hasn't shipped?
settings.answer: Yes. Place a new order, choose the Order additions shipping option and note the order number to combine with. If the combined total passes $300, we refund the shipping.

settings.question: My parcel arrived damaged
settings.answer: Note the damage when you receive it and email us with photos. We'll replace the item, or give you a credit or refund.

settings.question: Can I return an unopened game?
settings.answer: Yes, for change of mind: let us know in writing within 7 days. The game must be unopened and in its original packaging. Preorders, special orders, sleeves and accessories are excluded. We offer an exchange or store credit.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Email us for a Return Product Number (RPN) before sending anything back.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. All prices are in AUD.

settings.question: How does bank transfer work?
settings.answer: Choose bank transfer at checkout and use your order number as the reference. We ship once payment arrives. Unpaid orders are cancelled after 3 business days.

settings.question: How is a game's Complexity rating determined?
settings.answer: Complexity ratings on product pages come from BoardGameGeek, the hobby's main source of discussion and knowledge. Games are rated out of 5: 1 is very light and easy to learn, 5 is highly complex. Ratings are submitted by players, so they're subjective and change over time, but they're a good guide to how heavy a game will feel.

settings.question: Which edition is this game?
settings.answer: English retail editions unless tagged otherwise. German editions, Kickstarter editions (KS) and Deluxe editions (DELUXE) are marked in the title.

settings.question: Why are board games expensive in Australia?
settings.answer: [Dean to write]

settings.text: Dean answers every message himself, usually within a business day.
